registry.description: Praise is the outward expression of one's highest valuation of what is genuinely great and good. The Hebrew vocabulary is exceptional in its breadth: to shine (hallel), to give thanks with outstretched hands (yadah), to sing (zamar), to shout (rua), to boast in the best sense. Praise is directed toward God because he alone is fully worthy of it — the one whose greatness exceeds every other greatness. In Scripture, praise is not merely devotional expression; it is the confession of reality: God is what he is, and praise is the acknowledgement of that.
